sentences.en: That evening tea was partaken of in a grim silence.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，大家沉默地喝了茶。

sentences.en: We spent most of the evening talking about our vacation.
sentences.zh: 大部分时间我们都在谈论假期。

sentences.en: The accident took place on the evening of last Sunday.
sentences.zh: 事故发生在上周日傍晚。
